'''Howzmin''' was a loyal servant of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], and was short, squat, and bald [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="SotESB" /> 
==Biography==
Howzmin was chief of security and operations in [[Xizor's Palace]], and unofficial [[captain/Legends|captain]] of its [[Xizor's personal guards|guards]], overseeing their hiring and training. From the Palace's surveillance information center, he monitored various locations within the palace, especially its network of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] tubeways connected to its entrances; he also coordinated Xizor's counter-[[spy/Legends|espionage]] [[agent/Legends|agents]] and was responsible for the [[blast door/Legends|blast door]] codes.<ref name="SotESB" />

In his capacity as a gatekeeper, he expected Xizor's important guests outside the Palace, and sometimes personally he guided them (sometimes blindfolded) within.<ref name="SotESB" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> it was Howzmin who told [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lonay]] when Xizor would meet his [[Sublieutenant/Legends|sublieutenants]] and he started preparing.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Regalia of Office|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Soon after all nine Vigos gathered in the antechamber and Howzmin supervised their search by the guards, and they removed their weapons before [[Guri]] summoned them.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

He was given the task of arranging the meeting between Xizor and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. With the assistance of [[Guri]], Howzmin secured the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] disguises for Leia ([[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]]) and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] ([[Snoova]]). He had a paging device implanted in his head. Shortly before Chewbacca's escape from Xizor's palace, he was seen on the floor by Leia.

==Personality and traits==
Howzmin had an unsettling appearance; he was bald, squat, and short, with black-[[chrome]]d [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], seen whenever he smiled. He was generally silent, guiding the guests with gestures and nods. He was almost always seen in his grey [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and [[blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="SotESB" />

He had received life-like [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants to see in the dark and to be silently summoned by Xizor; perhaps the cause of his demeanor as a loyal [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]].<ref name="SotESB" />
